test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Fill in the blanks: The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) has assigned weightage to both the share of a state in the overall forest area, and its share in the increase in overall forest area between ____ and ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015 and 2023.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) significantly modified the 'Forest' criterion to incentivize both conservation and the expansion of green cover.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Commission now considers a state's share in the total forest area and its specific contribution to the increase in forest cover between the years 2015 and 2023.**
 
• Unlike the 15th FC, which only looked at dense and moderately dense forests, the 16th FC includes "open forests" in its calculations.
 
• This change aims to reward states that have actively worked towards increasing their environmental footprint over the last eight years.
 
• The overall weightage for the Forest parameter remains unchanged at 10%.
 
• Forest Criterion (FC-16)__
 __
 
• Total Weightage - 10%
 
• Components - Existing area + Increase in area
 
• Evaluation Period - 2015 to 2023
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Open Forests__

 __
 
• Lands with tree canopy density between 10% and 40%. Their inclusion by FC-16 broadens the scope of ecological rewards.
 
 
 
• 15th Finance Commission (Comparison)__
 __
 
• The 15th FC used "Forest and Ecology" as a parameter but focused solely on the existing share of dense forest area without rewarding the growth rate.
 
 
 
• Ecological Services__
 
 
• By assigning weight to forests, the Commission compensates states for the disability of not being able to use forest land for industrial or agricultural purposes.
